sector: Independent European fine jewelry house making and selling pieces through its own boutique and a small number of stockists.
founded_place_size: An independent European house run by its founder, selling from one boutique plus a handful of stockists.
about: Maison Serault is a small fine jewelry house built around its founder's own hand. Pieces are made and sold through the boutique and a few trusted stockists, and everything leaves in packaging people keep. The house is changing box suppliers, and the new supplier needs proper artwork before it will quote.
audience: Buyers roughly 30 to 55 purchasing as a gift or for themselves, plus a small number of stockists. They value discretion and craft over logos.
price_positioning: Fine jewelry from 600 to 4,000 dollars. Positioned as an independent house: hairline refinement, high contrast, a small mark on a large quiet field, never mass market and never loud.

palette.name: Serault Ink
palette.role: mandatory wherever type sits on Card Cream
palette.usage: Every line of type on Card Cream: the piece name, reference, metal, price and care copy, as on serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf, and the address block and any body text on the stationery. It may also be the one flat colour of wordmark.svg, monogram.svg or a mark printed in ink. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Warm Brass
palette.role: mandatory for the foil monogram on the packaging label
palette.usage: The foil: the supplier's foil in serault_supplier_specs.txt and the monogram on serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf, so the monogram foil-blocked on the label and any mark foil-blocked elsewhere. It may also be the one flat colour of wordmark.svg or monogram.svg. Never set type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Card Cream
palette.role: mandatory as the ground of the packaging label and of both stationery pages
palette.usage: The card and page ground: the Card Cream the supplier names for the enclosure card in serault_supplier_specs.txt and the ground of serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf. Never a fill inside wordmark.svg or monogram.svg, which stay transparent.

palette.name: Boutique Charcoal
palette.role: reserved for the box board; not used in these four deliverables
palette.usage: The very dark box board named in serault_supplier_specs.txt, on which the Warm Brass foil sits. It is not a ground, panel, type, rule or mark colour in wordmark.svg, monogram.svg, the packaging label or the stationery, and serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf does not use it.

palette.name: Soft Stone
palette.usage: Hairline rules and the border of the piece window only, as on serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf. Never type, a mark, a ground or a panel.

typography: Maison Serault sets its name in Marian 1800 Regular, caps, tracked 0.30 em: 96 pt on 104 pt in the boutique window and 14 pt on 16 pt on a packaging label, with the identical 0.4 pt hairline at both, which is the whole point of the mark. Marian has no weight range, so the step between those two is made by size and empty field, never by weight, and it is never emboldened or outlined. At either size the wordmark holds exactly one third of the sheet width, centred in otherwise empty field. Body is Graphik Regular at 9.5 pt on 14 pt, tracking 0, held to 65 characters a line. Care copy is Graphik Regular at 6.5 pt on 9 pt, tracking +0.03 em.
voice: Spare, assured, unhurried. A line the house would write: "Each piece is finished by hand and meant to outlive its first wearer."
brand_assets_status: The working files are gone. The wordmark survives only as one flat export from 2019 whose source files were never sent, a phone photograph of brushed brass letters on the boutique wall, and a daylight photograph of the monogram foil blocked on an old card. The three disagree about the house colour, and there is no vector master of either mark.
values: Discretion and permanence. A decision made about the mark now sits on packaging for the next ten years, so it has to be right.

palette_rules.distribution: The packaging label and both stationery pages have a Card Cream ground and nothing else; wordmark.svg and monogram.svg have no ground and stay transparent. On Card Cream, every line of type is Serault Ink, as on serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf. Marks are not type: the foil monogram on the label is Warm Brass, the supplier's foil, and every other wordmark or monogram, in wordmark.svg, monogram.svg, on the label or on the stationery, is one flat colour, Serault Ink or Warm Brass. Soft Stone is for hairline rules and the piece-window border only, no more than 5% of the designed area, never a ground, panel, type or mark. Boutique Charcoal is the box board and is not used in these four deliverables.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. Foil is shown as a flat Warm Brass fill, as on serault_enclosure_card_press.pdf.
palette_rules.forbidden: In these four deliverables no colour other than Serault Ink #1B2A2E, Warm Brass #B08D4C, Card Cream #EFE9DC and Soft Stone #C9BEA8 is used for any ground, type, mark, rule or icon; Boutique Charcoal #2A2724 is kept for the box board. No gradient, bevel, glow or drop shadow on any mark or type, and no emboldened or hollow outline lettering: the brand is a small mark on a large quiet field, never loud.
palette_rules.photography: No photograph appears in any deliverable: serault_wordmark_export_2019.png, serault_wall_sign.jpg and serault_card_monogram.jpg are recovery sources only, and none is placed on the label or the stationery. Every mark is flat vector artwork in one palette colour.
